description: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two Text-to-SQL models — NatSQL and TA-SQL — across four categories: Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents “Execution Accuracy” on a linear scale ranging from 20 to 60, with tick marks at intervals of 10. The horizontal axis lists the four difficulty categories. For each category, two adjacent bars are shown: a light gray bar for NatSQL and a dark blue bar for TA-SQL. In the “Simple” category, NatSQL achieves 60.21% accuracy while TA-SQL reaches 63.14%. In “Moderate,” NatSQL scores 39.64% and TA-SQL 48.60%. For “Challenging,” NatSQL scores 32.32% and TA-SQL 36.11%. The “Total” accuracy across all categories is 51.35% for NatSQL and 56.19% for TA-SQL. Across all categories, TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL, with the largest relative gain observed in the Moderate category. The chart visually emphasizes TA-SQL’s superior performance through consistently taller dark blue bars, and the values are explicitly labeled atop each bar for precise comparison.
